title: SID MEDICOS expands LemonBottle network in Latin America
summary: Following its third regional industry event of 2026, the South Korean aesthetics company is exploring distribution partnerships and plans to extend its product range into aftercare and daily skincare

extraction.key_fact: SID MEDICOS가 중남미에서 레몬보틀 유통망을 넓히고 있다.
